mapper.select: SELECT name,url FROM graph_info WHERE item_type=1 AND item_id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY id
mapper.sql: FROM lease_agreement l LEFT JOIN apartment_info a ON a.id=l.apartment_id AND a.is_deleted=0 LEFT JOIN room_info r ON r.id=l.room_id AND r.is_deleted=0
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id,l.room_id,l.status lease_status,l.lease_start_date,l.lease_end_date,l.source_type,l.rent, a.name apartment_name,r.room_number
WHERE l.is_deleted=0 AND l.phone=#{phone} ORDER BY l.id DESC

SELECT l.*, a.name apartment_name,r.room_number,p.name payment_type_name,t.month_count lease_term_month_count,t.unit lease_term_unit
LEFT JOIN payment_type p ON p.id=l.payment_type_id AND p.is_deleted=0 LEFT JOIN lease_term t ON t.id=l.lease_term_id AND t.is_deleted=0 WHERE l.is_deleted=0 AND l.id=#{id} AND l.phone=#{phone}
